what: Blind paired comparison of raw-native's CRT and film shaders against the strongest existing shaders, on identical frames
status: protocol only; no comparison has run. The competitor renders need RetroArch or librashader and the libretro slang-shaders repository on this machine, which needs the author's approval to download.
claim_rule: No superiority claim is made for any shader unless this protocol has run and its decision rule is met. Losses are recorded with the same prominence as wins.

crt.competitor_use: Rendered output only, run unmodified in their own runtime. No line of their code enters raw-native.
crt.settings: Each competitor at its own default preset, plus the one preset its documentation recommends for the matching mask type. raw-native at the matching preset (pvm-20 for aperture grille RGB, slot-tv for slot mask composite, vga-14 for delta).
frames: three game-like frames at 256 x 224 and 320 x 240 chosen by the author before the run
crt.output: 3840 x 2880 and 1920 x 1440, the same crop for every shader, shown at 1:1 on the same display
crt.reference: Best case: macro photographs of a real tube (aperture grille, slot mask) showing the same frame, if the author can provide them; then the task is 'which is closer to the photograph'. Otherwise the task is 'which looks more like a real CRT'.
crt.raters: The author plus any other volunteers. Model judges are not used as raters.
crt.design: Two-alternative forced choice. Each pair shown twice with sides swapped. Order and sides randomised with a seed committed here before the run: 20261010.
crt.metric: Win rate of raw-native against each competitor with a 95% Wilson interval, per frame set and per resolution.
crt.decision_rule: raw-native 'preferred' over a competitor only when the lower bound of the 95% interval is above 0.5. 'Not distinguishable' when the interval spans 0.5. 'Lost' when the upper bound is below 0.5.

competitors: an open GPL or MIT film emulation if one is found and licensed for running
frames: three scene-linear frames from the films or the Studio, chosen before the run
film.reference: Best case: the same scene shot on film and scanned. Otherwise 'which looks more like a film print'.

internal_baseline: Before the external panel, raw-native's physical CRT is shown beside the Studio's own retro-crt.js on the same frame (tools/shaders/sheets.mjs). That shows a difference, not a preference, and is not a superiority claim.
